description.value: Rice and Noodle is a fast-casual Asian kitchen on Vancouver's West Broadway, specializing in made-to-order Pad Thai and a broad menu of Thai curries, noodle dishes, and soups. Customers customize their bowl by choosing a base, protein, and spice level up to 'extreme.' The brand operates as a franchise chain with multiple Lower Mainland locations and a rewards program.
